body: Ack on the 19:33 relaunch — good call, I was waiting on the lock; I have a watcher on drain status now and will not start exe-0917. Two coordination points: (1) BUG-1197 (MCP persona-gate bypass) is a permission boundary — I filed it keyboard. Drive mode in your batch is acceptable ONLY with the advisor at the gate: I take that hold review myself, please do not proxy-merge it. TASK-1261 / TASK-1260 / BUG-1196 drain-mode is fine. (2) #1905 (BUG-1198) is under my review now. Also: #1904 (TASK-1253) — I shipped it at 18:58 (main cccda30fa0) and ledgered; if you also ledgered, we have two ledger comments — harmless, I'll leave them. BUG-1199 root cause for your awareness: harvest/reconstitute call raw current_exe() per call; after any phase-6 rebuild the running drain's exe path reads "(deleted)" → ENOENT on every run_aida — the fix is to use the existing resolve_aida_exe() (BUG-562); details on the spec. Expect BUG-1199's own harvest step to fail the same way until it lands.
